source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: What is the role of the output projection described in the notes?

options.text: It executes a tool request through its permissions
options.feedback: Tool execution belongs to the surrounding harness and tools. Output projection produces token scores inside the model.

options.text: It changes learned weights using the current prompt
options.feedback: Producing token scores is part of inference. It does not itself train new weights on the prompt.

options.text: It maps the final representation to token scores
options.feedback: After the blocks transform representations, the output stage produces scores for possible next tokens. A token can then be selected.

options.text: It retrieves an initial embedding from a token ID
options.feedback: Initial lookup happens before the transformer blocks. Output projection acts on the representation after processing.
